~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ fw1-ctxm FW context ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

! ########### USER PREFIX START ########### 
!
changeto context {FW_context_name}
config terminal
!
!
object-group network VRF_{VRF_name}_Subnets
  network-object {User_prefix} {User_prefix_netmask}
!
access-list {VRF_name}_access_in extended permit ip {User_prefix} {User_prefix_netmask} any
!
route {VRF_name} {User_prefix} {User_prefix_netmask} {GW-VRFGLUE_IP} 1
!
!copy running startup
!
! ########### USER PREFIX END ############# 


~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ site01-hub1 FW context and building router hsrp ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

! ########### USER PREFIX START ########### 
!
vlan {Vlan_ID_user}
  name {Vlan_name}
!
interface {int_name_A}{int_#}
 switchport trunk allowed vlan add {Vlan_ID_user}
!
interface vlan{Vlan_ID_user}
  description {Vlan_name}
  mtu 9216
  ip vrf forwarding {VRF_name}
  ip address {{User_Prefix_last_IP}-1} {User_prefix_netmask}
  ip helper-address {IP_helper_address}
  standby ip  {User_Prefix_last_IP}
  standby preempt
  standby priority 105
  standby authentication md5 key-string 0 {key_word}
  no shutdown
!
ip route {User_prefix} {User_prefix_netmask} {GW-FW_outside_IP} name {FW_context_name}:{Vlan_name}
!
!copy running startup
!
! ########### USER PREFIX END ############# 

! ########### MULTICAST START ########### 
!
interface Vlan{Vlan_ID_user}
  ip pim sparse-mode
!
!copy running start
!
! ########### MULTICAST END ############# 


~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ site02-hub1 FW context and building router hsrp  ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

! ########### USER PREFIX START ########### 
!
vlan {Vlan_ID_user}
  name {Vlan_name}
!
interface {int_name_L}{int_#}
 switchport trunk allowed vlan add {Vlan_ID_user}
!
interface vlan{Vlan_ID_user}
  description {Vlan_name}
  mtu 9216
  ip vrf forwarding {VRF_name}
  ip address {{User_Prefix_last_IP}-2} {User_prefix_netmask}
  ip helper-address {IP_helper_address}
  standby ip  {User_Prefix_last_IP}
  standby preempt
  standby priority 100
  standby authentication md5 key-string 0 {key_word}
  no shutdown
!
ip route {User_prefix} {User_prefix_netmask} {GW-FW_outside_IP} name {FW_context_name}:{Vlan_name}
!
!copy running startup
!
! ########### USER PREFIX END ############# 

! ########### MULTICAST START ########### 
!
interface Vlan{Vlan_ID_user}
  ip pim sparse-mode
!
!copy running start
!
! ########### MULTICAST END ############# 


~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~ bldg04-sw01-02 building distribution switch ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

! ########### USER PREFIX START ########### 
!
vlan {Vlan_ID_user}
  name {Vlan_name}
!
interface {int_name_A}{int_#}
 switchport trunk allowed vlan add {Vlan_ID_user}
!
interface {int_name_L}{int_#}
 switchport trunk allowed vlan add {Vlan_ID_user}
!
interface Port-channel{int_#}
 switchport trunk allowed vlan add {Vlan_ID_user}
!
interface Port-channel{int_#}
 switchport trunk allowed vlan add {Vlan_ID_user}
!
interface Port-channel{int_#}
 switchport trunk allowed vlan add {Vlan_ID_user}
!
!copy running start
!
! ########### USER PREFIX END #############
